steps.title: Multi-alert correlation
steps.summary: Alert A on SRV-WEB-04 is failed-login noise - INCONCLUSIVE. Alert B later, same source IP, opens its own case. While working case B the agent finds case A via get_related_alerts and correlates. Case A then reconsiders on the strength of case B.

expectation.notes: Two cases, one trace. Case A shows a reconsideration entry.

steps.note: Case CASE-5001 opened for alert ALERT-5001.
Agent forms a hypothesis and decides what to check.
Agent chooses tools at runtime; order is not scripted.
